framework: AWS Security Best Practices + Passive Pentest Correlation
description: Detection of potentially network-exploitable systems without active scanning

items.title: EC2 instance with administrative ports exposed to the internet
items.description: EC2 instances with world-open SSH/RDP rules in their security group AND an active IGW route increase the risk of initial access.
items.remediation: Restrict SSH/RDP to specific admin IPs, use a bastion host or VPN, and remove world-open ingress rules.

pci_dss.reason: Limit inbound traffic to authorized sources only.

items.title: Internet-reachable EC2 instance with active Inspector findings
items.description: EC2 instances reachable from the internet that also have active Inspector vulnerability findings have an elevated probability of exploitation.
items.remediation: Close unnecessary network exposure and prioritize patching of Inspector findings on internet-reachable instances.

pci_dss.reason: Vulnerabilities with high exploitability on exposed components must be mitigated as a priority.

items.title: ECS service reachable from the internet via internet-facing ALB
items.description: An ECS service exposed via an internet-facing ALB without application-layer security controls increases the attack surface.
items.remediation: Review whether public exposure is required. Implement WAF, ALB authentication, and port restrictions.

pci_dss.reason: Traffic from the internet to the CDE must be limited to authorized components.

items.title: Lambda Function URL publicly accessible without authentication
items.description: Function URLs with AuthType NONE allow public invocation without any identity control.
items.remediation: Use AWS_IAM auth type or expose the function via API Gateway with robust authentication and authorization.

pci_dss.reason: Access to system components must require authentication.

items.title: Lambda exposed via API Gateway without authorization
items.description: API Gateway routes with AuthorizationType NONE (excluding CORS OPTIONS preflight) expose Lambda functions without identity controls.
items.remediation: Configure authorization on API Gateway (IAM, Cognito, Lambda Authorizer) or restrict by CORS policy.

pci_dss.reason: Access to system components must require identification and authentication.

items.title: Publicly accessible RDS instance with permissive security group
items.description: RDS instances with PubliclyAccessible=true and world-open database ports significantly increase the attack surface.
items.remediation: Disable public access on RDS and restrict security groups to authorized private networks.

pci_dss.reason: CDE components must not be directly exposed to the internet.

items.title: Asset with multiple high exploitability signals correlated
items.description: Correlation of network exposure and high-impact context suggesting a probable exploitation risk. Reachability, vulnerability, and blast-radius scores all exceed critical thresholds.
items.remediation: Prioritize hardening of the affected asset, simultaneously reducing exposure, privilege scope, and attack surface.

pci_dss.reason: High risks must be prioritized with compensating controls and timely remediation.

items.title: Internet-exposed instance with CISA KEV vulnerability
items.description: An EC2 instance exposed to the internet has a vulnerability listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, indicating active exploitation in the wild.
items.remediation: Immediately patch the affected CVE. If a patch is unavailable, isolate the instance by restricting security group ingress and disabling public IP or removing IGW route.

pci_dss.reason: Known exploited vulnerabilities on internet-exposed components must be remediated as highest priority.
Vulnerabilities actively exploited in the wild represent the highest risk to the CDE.

notes: v1.3: added qsa_visibility to all items. v1.2: added SER-CVE-001 (CISA KEV + internet exposure). v1.1: added SER-ECS-001 (ECS via ALB) and SER-LMB-002 (API GW unauth, OPTIONS excluded). SER-EC2-001 verifies IGW route to reduce false positives on private subnets.
